required_before_generation.description: Classify 101 types into roles. Required to set workflow_root_candidate_count > 0 in family-generation-readiness-rank.
Review 51 options types. Identify which are required vs optional for each WORKFLOW_ROOT candidate.
Confirm that programmatic PDF creation via Aspose.Pdf.Document() works as input strategy. Validate that generated PDFs pass DllReflector reflection.
Map PDF to a dedicated target repo (e.g., aspose-pdf-net/Aspose.PDF.LowCode-for-.NET-Examples). Configure in pdf.yml.

required_config_changes: pdf.yml: status must change from discovery_only to active
pdf.yml: allowed_types must be populated with pilot-approved types
pdf.yml: published_plugin_examples_repo must point to family-specific repo (not central placeholder)

proposed_pilot_scope.rationale: Select types that are simple, well-understood, and don't require complex fixture setup. Prefer types with programmatic input creation (no external fixture file needed).

proposed_initial_types.input_strategy: programmatic_input (2× Aspose.Pdf.Document with 1 page each, saved as input1.pdf and input2.pdf)
proposed_initial_types.output_validation: output PDF exists, byte count > 0, %PDF header check
output PDFs exist, page count per part matches expectation
output PDF exists and is smaller than or equal to input size

proposed_initial_types.input_strategy: programmatic_input (Aspose.Pdf.Document with known text added via TextFragment)
proposed_initial_types.confidence: medium (text extraction pattern differs from file-output pattern)

types_deferred_to_later_pilot: FormEditor / FormFlattener / FormExporter / FormImporter — require PDF with form fields (complex fixture)
Html — HTML-to-PDF may require license check
TableGenerator — requires table data object construction (complex builder pattern)

fixture_strategy.mechanism: Generate input PDF files in-line within the generated C# Program.cs, using Aspose.Pdf.Document() API
fixture_strategy.notes: template_hints section already present in pdf.yml. These hints will be used by packet_builder.py to guide LLM code generation.

validation_strategy.output_validation: PDF output: check file exists + %PDF header (first 4 bytes)
validation_strategy.example_reviewer: Aspose example-reviewer if available for PDF
validation_strategy.text_extraction_validation: For TextExtractor: verify extracted text contains known string placed during programmatic input creation

pdf_specific_notes: PDF LowCode uses instance-method pattern, not static: new Merger().Process(options) — not Merger.Process(...)
Always construct options object first, then call AddInput()/AddOutput()
Use FileDataSource for file-path inputs, FileSaveTarget for file-path outputs
ResultContainer is returned by Process() — check IsSuccess before reading results
Aspose.Pdf namespace needed for programmatic input creation: using Aspose.Pdf;

pdf_yml_changes_needed: generation.preferred_methods_per_type: {Merger: Process, Splitter: Process, Optimizer: Process, TextExtractor: Process}
